relationships.subject: dezocine combined with dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, the levels of inflammatory factors tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) and hs-CRP, and myocardial injury-related factors LDH and creatine kinase MB (CKMB) as well as ET-1 at 12 h after intervention declined remarkably in observation group compared with control group (p<0.05).

relationships.subject: dezocine combined with dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: However, the levels of nitric oxide (NO), VEGF and basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF) rose significantly in the observation group (p<0.05).

relationships.subject: dezocine combined with dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: NRS pain score at 1, 4, 8 and 12 h after intervention decreased remarkably in the observation group compared with the control group (p<0.05).

key_findings: Dezocine plus dexmedetomidine in HIPEC patients reduced adverse reactions, pain scores, TNF-α, hs-CRP and ET-1 while raising NO, VEGF and bFGF.
LVMI correlated positively with hs-CRP and LDH and negatively with ET-1 and VEGF.
